Privacy Policy

Paid - Easy Invoice Maker

Effective Date: December 11, 2025

Introduction

Paid is an invoicing application that helps you create and manage professional invoices. We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our data practices. This privacy policy explains how we handle information in our app.

Data Collection

We Collect No Personal Data

Paid does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information, invoice data, client lists, or financial information to external servers or third parties.

What We Don't Collect:

  • •Your invoice details (amounts, items, client instructions)
  • •Client information (names, addresses, emails)
  • •Your business details or logo
  • •Usage analytics or app behavior data

Data Storage

Your data is stored securely on your device and in your personal iCloud container:

  • •Stored locally on your device's internal storage
  • •Synced securely to your private iCloud container using Apple's CloudKit
  • •We do not have access to your data in CloudKit
  • •Never transmitted to our external servers
  • •Completely under your control

PDF Generation

When you generate a PDF invoice, the file is created locally on your device. We do not see, store, or have access to these files. You choose how to share them (email, messaging, etc.) using your device's standard sharing capabilities.

App Permissions

Paid may request the following permissions:

Storage / File Access

Required to save and export your generated PDF invoices to your device.

Third-Party Services

Paid does not integrate with any third-party analytics platforms, advertising networks, or external APIs.

Data Security

Since we don't collect or store any personal data remotely, there is no risk of a data breach on our servers impacting your information. However, you are responsible for securing access to your physical device.

Children's Privacy

Our app is safe for users of all ages as we do not collect any personal information.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our app, please contact us:

Digitalsprout
Email: info@digitalsprout.org
Website: digitalsprout.org

Privacy Summary

Paid is 100% offline-first tailored. We don't spy on your business. Your invoices, clients, and data stay on your phone.
